caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest with a notched collar, rendered in a realistic style against a plain light beige background. The vest is patterned with a grid of wide, horizontal and vertical stripes in different shades of brown, intersected by thinner blue and white lines, creating a tartan or plaid effect. The body and collar of the vest prominently display these patterns, with the blue and white lines running parallel to and across the brown base. There are buttons along the front opening, and two welt pockets are visible on either side near the bottom. The inside lining under the armhole and behind the collar appears to be a solid light brown. The drawing pays detailed attention to the texture and fabric folds, making the vest appear three-dimensional and lifelike.
title: Waistcoat
